title: Materialised views, scheduled queries and BI Engine

videos.script: Quitanda's dashboards ask the same question every hour. Sales per district, per day. {{same}} The answer for last month has not changed since last month. Reading a million orders to find it again is waste. {{waste}} A materialised view stores the answer and keeps it current. When new orders arrive, it aggregates only those. {{mv}} You will do that by hand on DuckDB. Build sixty days of an aggregate, then add one day, reading one day's orders. {{incremental}} BigQuery can rewrite a dashboard's query to read the view, without anyone changing the report. {{rewrite}} What a view cannot hold, a scheduled query can. A median, say, recomputed every night. {{schedule}} And BI Engine keeps the small tables in memory, so the dashboard reads them fast, and on demand for nothing. {{bi}} In that order. Make the answer small first, then make it fast. {{order}}
